summary.text: Cindy Bennett is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She has represented the district since December 2024 and works as a math teacher, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Bennett was born in New Hampshire.
Her career experience includes working as a math teacher.
Ballotpedia lists a prior office for her as an at-large member of the Raymond School District board.
